login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to your Healthy360 account.
login.failed: Those details do not match our records.
login.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor confirmation
twoFactor.subtitle: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: One of the codes you saved when two-factor was switched on.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: One Healthy360 account works across every clinic and kitchen you belong to.
register.acceptTerms: I accept the terms of service

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email address and we will send you a reset link.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Your new password must be different from any you have used before.
resetPassword.successBody: You can now sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.invalidToken: This reset link has expired. Request a new one.
resetPassword.missingLink: This page needs the link from your reset email.
resetPassword.missingLinkBody: Open the link we sent you, or request a new one.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.body: We have sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to finish setting up your account.
verifyEmail.resent: A new link is on its way.
verifyEmail.wrongAddress: Signed in as the wrong person?
verifyEmail.cooldown: You can send another link in {{seconds}} seconds.
verifyEmail.pendingBody: We have not seen a confirmation yet. Open the link, then check again.

organisationPicker.title: Choose an organisation
organisationPicker.subtitle: Your permissions differ between organisations, so pick where you are working now.
organisationPicker.empty: You do not belong to any organisation yet.
organisationPicker.emptyBody: Ask an administrator to invite you, or continue with your personal account.

branchPicker.title: Choose a branch
branchPicker.subtitle: {{organisation}} works across several sites. Pick the one you are at.
branchPicker.empty: This organisation has no branches you can open.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.subtitle: What Healthy360 knows about your account. Editing arrives with the identity module.

devices.title: Devices and sessions
devices.subtitle: Everywhere your account is signed in. Revoke anything you do not recognise.
devices.emptyBody: This is the only device signed in to your account.
devices.revokeBody: {{device}} will be signed out immediately and will need to sign in again.

stepUp.title: Confirm your password
stepUp.body: This is a sensitive change, so please confirm it is you.
